title: Catalog sync skips groups checkpointed before prices joined the pass, so they get no prices
description: Groups ingested within the resume window are skipped. Groups checkpointed by the pre-CSV catalog sync (products only) are skipped too, so their prices are never stored by catalog-sync. Record prices_synced_at on the checkpoint when a pass stores prices, and when the runner stores prices only resume past groups whose prices were stored within the window.
close_reason: Checkpoints record prices_synced_at when the catalog pass stores prices; when the sync stores prices it resumes past a group only as of that time, falling back to the group's latest card market_price_synced_at for older checkpoints. Live check: next run re-syncs Magic/YuGiOh/Pokemon, skips the 1,386 groups priced in the last 24h.

title: Catalog CSV parse fails for groups with no price columns
description: make catalog-sync failed: decode /tcgplayer/17/24919/ProductsAndPrices.csv: missing subTypeName column. TCGCSV omits every price column for a group with no prices (unreleased Force of Will set). parseProductsAndPrices now requires only productId and name.
close_reason: Parser treats a missing subTypeName column as no price rows; test added, gate green.

title: Broad catalog sync halts at empty groups (HTTP 404), so categories after 69 never sync
description: A full make catalog-sync stops at the first group whose product file 404s and resumes at the same group next run, so it never gets past it. catalog_sync_state shows the only failure is Marvel Comics (cat 69) group 23218 (/tcgplayer/69/23218/products -> 404), and no category above 69 has ever been checkpointed (Disney Lorcana 71, Star Wars Unlimited, etc.). TCGCSV's FAQ says categories 9, 10, 12, 14, 21, 55, 69, 70 are empty and should be skipped. Fix: in Runner.RunOnce, treat ErrNotFound from syncGroup like a missing groups feed during a broad sync (log, record failure, continue), and/or skip TCGCSV's known-empty categories in IsTradingCardCategory.
close_reason: Broad syncs skip TCGCSV's known-empty categories (9,10,12,14,21,55,69,70) and checkpoint a 404 group as empty instead of stopping; targeted --group syncs still report the 404. Gate green.

title: Strip malformed <br fragments left in 8 stored card descriptions
description: After the description backfill (monmetrics-fgv), 8 rows still show a literal '<br' because TCGplayer's Card Text has malformed tags with no closing '>': '<br<Each', '<br.', '<br A player', '<br[CONT]' (Kiritos Strong Bond x4, Strange Girl Anya, 30th Celebration Battle Deck Case, Astral Radiance Premium Checklane Blister Case, Celebrations Ultra Premium Collection). Check: docker exec monmetrics_mongo mongosh --quiet monmetrics --eval 'db.cards.countDocuments({description: {$regex: "<br", $options: "i"}})'. Fix in backend/internal/catalog/descriptions.go (lineBreakTag) and re-run: go run ./cmd/catalog -clean-descriptions. Go regexp has no lookahead, so handle this without one.

title: CardDetail 'Current Market Price' says 'No sales data yet' for TCGplayer-priced cards
description: frontend/src/pages/CardDetail.tsx gates the Current Market Price panel on card.ebay_synced_at, so cards priced by TCGplayer ingest (current_price > 0, market_price_synced_at set) still show 'No sales data yet ... queued for eBay price collection'. With eBay blocked this is every card. Show current_price with market_price_synced_at when ebay_synced_at is absent.

title:
Card descriptions show raw TCGplayer HTML (
, ) from Card Text
description:
Catalog ingest copies TCGplayer Card Text verbatim into cards.description (backend/internal/catalog/normalize.go). The frontend renders it as plain text in frontend/src/pages/CardDetail.tsx, so tags appear literally, e.g. 'Each case includes 6 ...

Includes five ...'. About 37.6k of 47.2k described cards in the local DB contain HTML. Fix: convert
to newlines, strip other tags, decode entities at ingest; render with whitespace-pre-line.
notes:
Code fix done: cleanCardText runs at ingest (normalize.go), CardDetail uses whitespace-pre-line, catalog CLI has -clean-descriptions (local MongoDB only). Dry run: scanned=37632 changed=37627. Still open: run the backfill without -dry-run to rewrite existing rows; not committed.
Backfill run: scanned=37632 changed=37627 (dry_run=false). Verified: 0 stored descriptions with closing tags or entities. 8 malformed '<br' fragments remain, tracked in a follow-up bead.
close_reason: Ingest cleans Card Text; CardDetail preserves line breaks; 37,627 stored descriptions backfilled locally. Residual malformed <br fragments tracked as follow-up.

title: Show each card's printings (Normal/Holofoil/etc.) on card tiles and detail page
description: Store per-printing market prices on the card document during price ingest, backfill existing cards from stored prices, and render printings in CardGrid and CardDetail.
close_reason: Printings stored on cards at price ingest (+ backfill via go run ./cmd/prices -backfill-printings), shown on CardGrid tiles and a clickable Printings panel on CardDetail. Gates pass; backfilled 374,363 local cards; verified in browser.

title: Catalog sync: ingest products and prices from ProductsAndPrices.csv in one pass
description: Fetch /tcgplayer/{cat}/{group}/ProductsAndPrices.csv per group instead of the JSON products file, upsert cards, and write that day's prices in the same pass so make prices is no longer needed daily (halves TCGCSV requests). CSV url is a cpt.tcgcsv.com short link, so build https://www.tcgplayer.com/product/{id}; ext* columns map to extendedData names. Also lower CATALOG_REQUEST_DELAY default from 1s to 150ms.
close_reason: Catalog sync reads ProductsAndPrices.csv and stores prices via pricing.Runner.IngestGroupPrices; CATALOG_REQUEST_DELAY default 150ms. Gate green, CSV parity checked against live JSON for Pokemon 3170 and Magic 24463.

title: Dev server hydration mismatch on every page
description: In dev (make dev, :3000) index.html is served with the <!--app-html--> placeholder left as-is, but src/entry-client.tsx calls hydrateRoot, so React logs 'Hydration failed because the server rendered HTML didn't match the client' and re-renders the whole tree. Either SSR-render in dev or use createRoot when the root is empty.

title: Catalog sync ingests accessory categories whose names miss the nonTCGCategories list
description: Today's sync checkpointed Organizers and Stores, Protective Pages, Supply Bundles, Bulk Lots, Citadel Paints/Tools, Books and Warhammer categories. nonTCGCategories has 'organizers & stores' but TCGCSV now says 'Organizers and Stores', and the others aren't listed. Each costs requests against the 10k/day budget. Match by category ID or extend the name list.
